ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity (off-white/light-tan) to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels across visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated low-intensity black pigmentation forming contiguous bands along the lateral tips and proximal borders; high-intensity white dominates the central and medial lobe areas with localized low-intensity focal spots in the upper right lobe and near the center notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate angle of 30-40 degrees with significant vertical depth extending toward the peduncle attachment.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the boundary; distinct jagged peaks visible at the lateral distal tips; irregular pixel-valleys most prominent on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trailing edges tapering to sharp, upward-curved distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized yellowish-white raised clusters (possible barnacle attachments) visible on the left lobe surface and along the right trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant vertical linear disruption extending from the median notch; faint, multi-directional greyish-tan linear marks visible on the central-left lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep central notch cleft; irregular jagged wear on distal tips; surface discoloration (yellowish-tan biofilm) present on high-intensity regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black-to-white transition pattern at the lateral tips; distinct vertical dark lineation dividing the lower central fluke.
